description:
Functional specifications / files: lib/zaq_web/components/chat_message.ex delivery_status/delivery_details; channel_history_live.ex/html.heex; lib/zaq_web/history/channel_timeline.ex or actual projection owner verified before edits; existing Engine history read boundary. Reuse current status button and modal, not a new transcript card. Group only failed parts under one original-message delivery-details entry. Distinguish unconfirmed from rejected; successful messages remain ordinary transcript messages. Support partial-success visibility: current open_delivery_info only searches changes.pending_messages, so extend the authorized Engine projection/modal lookup to confirmed messages with supplemental failures. Do not create a duplicate pending bubble. Preserve live invalidation, modal refresh, keyboard focus and escape handling.
Tests before implementation: immediate component and LiveView tests for several failed parts in one modal, success plus failure, all failures, uncertainty labels, safe escaping/redaction, existing no-failure UI parity, authorization, refresh/reopen and no extra failed transcript rows. Existing browser suites may run; new feature E2E is deferred to approval-gated issue.
Branches: confirmed message with failures, pending/no-confirmation, legacy single reason, empty details, stale/deleted/unauthorized ID.
Mocking: real existing Engine read/events where practical; no direct BO persistence or Channels calls.
Documentation: component contract/story where existing stories apply; docs/services/channels.md presentation behavior. Read DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md, reuse local --zaq-* assets.
Action reuse: extend ChatMessage/BOModal and existing authorized history query/projection; UI presentation only, no Action. Engine supplies safe bounded facts; no raw provider errors, payloads or handles displayed.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.

comments.text: Using design skill for existing component extension. Read DESIGN.md token/layout/component constraints and BO guide; reviewed BOModal Storybook and existing delivery-status/modal implementation. No extraction, token migration or component replacement applies: reuse ChatMessage, BOModal, DSButton and current authorized message_changes read. User explicitly approved grouped-failure behavior in epic; final completed UX approval remains zaq-9j8.10 before feature E2E. Plan: safe failed-part rows inside existing modal, partial-success status on a normal canonical bubble, canonical+pending lookup on open/refresh, retain rating/info actions for canonical messages, unchanged focus/escape/close handling. No new transcript card or persistence/Action.
